what: the IN-TREE enumeration of the manufacturer/CAM written-acceptance items B01-B14 and the first-article validation groups FA01-FA10 that every release since D-789 has named only by count.  B01-B08 are Astra's Round-8 list, verbatim in substance.  B09-B14 and FA01-FA10 are this programme's own in-tree definition: the reviews added them by COUNT and the repository never held their text, so they are defined HERE, each mapped to a concrete step or fab-note item, and demo_feature_contract F12 refuses a release in which any FA group names a step the first-article plan does not contain.
status: EVERY ITEM PENDING -- pre-order analytical closure does not close any of these

manufacturer_cam.item: exact 6-layer stack (JLC06161H-7628), copper weights, finished thickness 1.5744 +/- 0.10 mm and ENIG, with no house-default substitution
every land-intersecting via resin-filled, planarised and copper-capped (POFV) as listed in the fab notes
the 38 sub-floor vias the fab notes list under 'SUB-FLOOR VIAS', at the stated finished sizes
mask and stencil apertures, including the U9/U12 pads and the NFC tuning terminals
MK1's acoustic port: unplated and unfilled
exact BOM, consignment, rotation and pin-1 per the CPL, the manual travelers, and 100 % electrical test
J4 finished barrels >= 0.70 mm and the exact tip/crimp/strain-relief process
the FOUR PLATED ROUTED SLOTS (Excellon G85) in the PTH drill file at J3's shield tabs, accepted as plated slots and not re-interpreted as round holes
the declared stackup used without substitution for the RF feeds and the USB pair drawn on it
genuine-source allocation for the AOS AO4800 pass pair and the nine constrained fitted sourcing groups (consignment or authorised stock)
first-article inspection report for the bottom-terminated packages (X-ray of U11 DLH0010A, U9, U12 and the ESP32 module ground pad) before the remaining units are released

first_article.title: radio, NFC and IR retained state, and IR self-blinding

first_article_prerequisites.status: IMPLEMENTED -- host-tested; build and bench execution pending hardware
first_article_prerequisites.item: the FIRST-ARTICLE TEST IMAGE: CC1101 continuous transmit and SX1262 CW at 22 dBm keyed only through SpiBusB::beginTransmit, an NFC field keyed only through DemoBringupApp::beginNfcFieldSession, a Wi-Fi/BLE TX burst, a 38 kHz IR transmit burst from D1, a chip-select hold-off injection for U7 and U9, a held audio drive at the capped level, a held backlight PWM duty after the D-784 prime and a 10 ms VCELL poll -- all under the release image's accessory permission table and quiesce/liveness rules; host-tested, recorded by git SHA, never shipped
first_article_prerequisites.flash: cd Firmware && pio run -e aqroot-demo-fap01 -t upload
first_article_prerequisites.never_default: default_envs is exactly and solely aqroot-demo (firmware_hw_map_contract H9); src/fap01/ and the define reach [env:aqroot-demo-fap01] alone (H10); re-flash the release image by name (pio run -e aqroot-demo -t upload) before the unit leaves the bench

console.C: CC1101 continuous TX, 433.92 MHz, PATABLE 0xC0, toggle, bounded 30 s -- C-RADIO-QUIESCE-01, C-MCU-01
console.L: SX1262 CW 915 MHz +22 dBm, toggle, bounded 30 s -- C-RADIO-QUIESCE-01, C-MCU-01
console.N: ST25R3916 field ON through beginNfcFieldSession, toggle, bounded 60 s -- C-NFC-TUNE-01, C-NFC-QUIESCE-01
console.T: one ISO14443A REQA while N is on, report only -- C-NFC-TUNE-01
console.V: operator declares the bench source (no charger, VBUS blocked), valid 120 s -- precondition of W
console.W: Wi-Fi TX burst, bounded 10 s, 30 s cool-down; asks wifiActivationPermitted and waives only its no-rail charging-row refusal after V -- C-MCU-01
console.I: ten 38 kHz NEC frames from D1 (~1.1 s) through the release blocking-test rule and burst slot -- C-IR-01
console.H: U7 CC1101_CS_N chip-select hold-off, toggle, bounded 60 s, survives one reset -- C-RADIO-QUIESCE-01
console.J: U9 NFC_CS_N chip-select hold-off, toggle, bounded 60 s, survives one reset -- C-NFC-QUIESCE-01
console.K: U9 NFC_CS_N hold-off applied after a 700 ms delay from the key, which lands during a rail admission's MAX17048 wait -- C-NFC-QUIESCE-01
console.Y: U9 hold-off beginning 2000 ms after the key (inside the settled recheck) -- C-NFC-QUIESCE-01
console.A: held audio at the release tone's level through the release amplifier mode edge, toggle, bounded 30 min -- C-THERM-01
console.B: held backlight PWM duty 50 % after the D-784 full-duty prime, toggle, bounded 30 min -- Q11-TEMP-01
console.G: raw VCELL every 10 ms for 2 s, timestamp and value per line -- C-GAUGE-EPOCH-01

first_article_prerequisites.host_proof: firmware_hw_map_contract H6 (test_fap01_image.cpp on the FAP-01 build and on the release build; test_production_image.cpp on the FAP-01 build), H9, H10

image_identity.git_sha: the D-801 content commit -- a commit cannot contain its own SHA, so it is recorded in hardware/demo/manufacturing/evidence/d801-review-target.json (fap01_image.git_sha) by the identity commit
image_identity.firmware_bin_sha256: the clean build of that commit, recorded in hardware/demo/manufacturing/evidence/d801-review-target.json (fap01_image.firmware_bin_sha256); the image actually flashed on each unit is re-hashed and recorded at the bench
